operator: For each Stage35 unsafe connected face patch independently, build its induced vertex-edge graph, remove candidate seam edges, compute anonymous local connected components, and mark an unsafe face mixed iff its vertices belong to more than one local component.
motivation: Global graph connectivity may bypass a true local seam outside the unsafe patch; topology ownership is local to the unsafe patch and does not require semantic region IDs.
teacher_policy: Teacher source topology is evaluation-only after all local patch components and mixed-face predictions are frozen.
